cohort: The study included a convenience sample of 19 normal, healthy term neonates.
finding: In this cohort of healthy term neonates, the mean SpO2 was 97% (SD 1), all neonates experienced 4-36 oxygen desaturation events per hour, and the mean proportion of time spent with oxygen saturations below 90% was approximately 3%.
cross-section timing: Oximetry recording started at a median postnatal age of 31 hours (IQR 28-41 hours), with four babies measured at <24 hours old.
